about.aboutMe: I take new products and systems from 0→1: writing the PRD and the technical design, then leading the team through launch.
about.aboutMe2: I'm a senior product engineer at Marshmallow, a Series C insurtech in London, where I joined in 2021 as one of the first hundred employees. I started as a junior, was promoted in 2022 and again in 2026, and now lead the architecture and technical direction of the telematics team.
about.aboutMe3: The work I enjoy most starts with no spec and no clear answer. I break the build into milestones that other engineers own, work with partners outside the codebase, such as hardware and logistics companies, and deputise for my engineering manager: running delivery syncs and retros, mentoring engineers, and moving the team to working AI first with Claude Code.
about.aboutMe4: Before Marshmallow I worked in health tech, building machine learning models with the NHS and prototyping at Medidata, and led industry projects with Intel and IBM during my MSc at UCL.
